name: OBHB
recent: OB Holdings 于2026年11月19日召开第3届常年股东大会，所有决议均获通过，包括董事薪酬、续聘核数师及更新关联交易授权。同期董事局出现变动，Dato' Haji Mohd Dusuki Bin Ya'acob 退任独立非执行董事，Wong Chung Theng 获委任为多个委员会成员。公司2026财年全年净利近乎翻倍，并提高股息。
notable: 第3届常年股东大会于2026年11月19日举行，所有决议均获股东通过。
Dato' Haji Mohd Dusuki Bin Ya'acob 退任独立非执行董事，并卸下多个委员会职务。
Wong Chung Theng 获委任为提名与薪酬委员会、风险委员会及审计委员会成员。
risks: 公司于2026年11月16日及9月17日公告重大诉讼事项。
董事 Miss Lee Bao Yu 于2026年9月29日申报在公开市场交易公司股份。
earnings: 2026财年第四季度（截至8月31日）营收为1449万令吉，环比下降21.2%，同比下降9.0%；净利为196万令吉，环比下降21.6%，同比增长14.1%；净利率为13.5%，上季度为13.6%。

recent_en: OB Holdings held its 3rd AGM on 19 Nov 2026, where all resolutions were passed, including directors' fees, auditor reappointment and renewal of related party transaction mandate. Board changes occurred with Dato' Haji Mohd Dusuki Bin Ya'acob ceasing as Independent Non-Executive Director and Wong Chung Theng appointed to several committees. The company nearly doubled its FY2026 net profit and raised its dividend.
notable_en: The 3rd AGM was held on 19 Nov 2026 and all resolutions were passed by shareholders.
Dato' Haji Mohd Dusuki Bin Ya'acob ceased as Independent Non-Executive Director and stepped down from several committees.
Wong Chung Theng was appointed as member of the Nomination and Remuneration Committee, Risk Committee and Audit Committee.
risks_en: The company announced material litigation on 16 Nov 2026 and 17 Sep 2026.
Director Miss Lee Bao Yu reported dealings in the company's shares outside closed period on 29 Sep 2026.
earnings_en: For 4Q FY2026 ended 31 Aug, revenue was RM14.49 million, down 21.2% QoQ and 9.0% YoY; net income was RM1.96 million, down 21.6% QoQ but up 14.1% YoY; net margin was 13.5% versus 13.6% in the previous quarter.
